context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend APIs for medication reminders, medication stats, and water history are fully working. Frontend has critical rendering bugs - the VERO Erinnerungen section on /medications page and the Medication Adherence + Water History cards on /progress page are not rendering despite correct API data. The code exists in the TSX files but the elements don't appear in the DOM. This appears to be a React rendering/state issue.
rca_of_the_issue: Root Cause Analysis: The frontend components have the correct JSX code for the new features, but the conditional rendering is not working. Possible causes: 1) State variables (medStats, waterHistory) not being set correctly from API responses, 2) React conditional rendering issue with the ternary operator structure in medications.tsx, 3) The API calls in progress.tsx init() may be failing silently. Reproduction: Navigate to /medications with profile_id set - medications show but reminder section doesn't. Navigate to /progress - charts show but medication/water cards don't. Mitigation: Add console.log debugging to verify state is being set, check for any JavaScript errors in browser console.
